name: LSeries.tendsto_cpow_mul_atTop
statement: ℕ → ℂ} {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ m ≤ n, f m = 0) (ha : abscissaOfAbsConv f < ⊤) : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ (n + 1) ^ (x : ℂ) * LSeries f x) atTop (nhds (f (n + 1)))

name: LSeries.tendsto_atTop
statement: ℕ → ℂ} (ha : abscissaOfAbsConv f < ⊤) : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ LSeries f x) atTop (nhds (f 1))

name: LSeries_sub_eventuallyEq_zero_of_LSeries_eventually_eq
statement: ℕ → ℂ} (hf : abscissaOfAbsConv f < ⊤) (hg : abscissaOfAbsConv g < ⊤) (h : (fun x : ℝ ↦ LSeries f x) =ᶠ[atTop] fun x ↦ LSeries g x) : (fun x : ℝ ↦ LSeries (f - g) x) =ᶠ[atTop] (0 : ℝ → ℂ)

name: LSeries.eq_of_LSeries_eventually_eq
statement: ℕ → ℂ} (hf : abscissaOfAbsConv f < ⊤) (hg : abscissaOfAbsConv g < ⊤) (h : (fun x : ℝ ↦ LSeries f x) =ᶠ[atTop] fun x ↦ LSeries g x) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : f n = g n
